headline: Executive order allows the military to call members of the Selected Reserve and some Individual Ready Reserve members to active duty.
what_it_does: This order authorizes ordering members of the Selected Reserve, and certain members of the Individual Ready Reserve, of the U.S. Armed Forces to active duty. Reservists who are called up would leave their civilian lives for a period of full-time military service. No summary was provided, so details such as how many people, for how long, and for what mission are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Selected Reserve (such as Reserve and National Guard units)
who_it_affects.how: They may be ordered to report for active-duty military service.

who_it_affects.group: Certain members of the Individual Ready Reserve
who_it_affects.how: These former service members who still have a reserve obligation may be recalled to active duty.

who_it_affects.group: Families and employers of reservists who are called up
who_it_affects.how: They may have a family member or worker leave for a period of active service.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 13, 2023; it likely took effect when signed.
